place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 柴房后面 · 泥地里
place.en: Chending Temple · Behind the woodshed · in the mud

setup.zh: 胸口的木牌烫了，烫得很久很久。小银狐钻出来，看着你的伤，一句话都没说——然后「呸」地吐出了一样东西。
setup.en: The token on your chest burns, and burns a long while. The little silver fox slips out, looks at your hurts and says nothing at all — then spits something out.

recap.zh: 银月一句话都没说，吐出了她的丹炉——一只巴掌大的小铜炉。「替本王看着它。」她说完最后半句就淡了下去：「……下次……打回去……」
recap.en: Yinyue said nothing at all; she spat out her furnace — a little bronze furnace the size of a palm. "Look after it for me." Her last half-sentence as she faded: "…next time… hit back…"

zh: 一只巴掌大的小铜炉，三只脚，两只耳。
en: A little bronze furnace the size of a palm: three legs, two ears.
"My furnace. I brought it down from the heavens."
"…What's your name?" The lid doesn't move.

label.en: The little beast on the lid

text.zh: 小兽闭着眼，只在你肚子咕咕叫的时候，才睁一睁。
text.en: The little beast keeps its eyes shut — it opens them only when your stomach growls.

text.zh: 笔画弯弯曲曲，像云又像火，你一个都不认得，只认得最后一个是「兜」。
text.en: The strokes curl like cloud, like flame. You can read none of them but the last: 兜.

text.zh: 炉身青里透紫，摸上去温温的，倒像刚吃饱了什么。
text.en: The body is green shot with purple and warm to the touch, as if it had just eaten its fill.

story.zh:
胸口的木牌，烫了。

这一次，烫得很久很久。

一只半透明的小银狐，从木牌里钻了出来。它蹲在你胸口上，低头看着你{外门·伤处}，看了很久很久。

它没有说话。它平常嘴那么毒，这时候，一句话都没有说。

然后，它张开嘴，「呸」地吐出了一样东西。

那东西落在你胸口上，叮当一声。一只巴掌大的小铜炉。三只脚，两只耳，炉身青里透紫，刻满了火焰和云。炉盖上蹲着一只小兽，打了个哈欠，睁开一只眼睛瞥了你一眼，又闭上了。

⟪**银月**：（声音很轻）本王的丹炉。仙界带下来的。替本王看着它。⟫

**你**：……它能干什么？

⟪**银月**：它会炼丹。你们凡人炼丹，十炉炸七炉……它不炸。它炼出来的……是你吃得下的，最好的……那一颗。还有，它嘴刁……尝过的丹……⟫

她的声音越来越小。

**你**：银月？

⟪**银月**：……它还会……⟫

她没说完。她的身子，像一缕烟一样淡了下去。最后剩下的，是半句很轻很轻的话：

⟪**银月**：……下次……打回去……⟫

木牌，凉了。

你捧着那只小铜炉，坐在泥地里，愣了很久。「嘴刁」是什么意思？「还会」——还会什么？

炉盖上的小兽睁开一只眼睛，瞥了你一眼，又闭上了。它显然知道。它显然不打算告诉你。

你把它翻过来看。炉底刻着几个字，笔画弯弯曲曲，像云，又像火。你一个都不认得。只认得最后一个字，是个「兜」。

**你**：……你叫什么？

炉盖，一动不动。

你心想，这等仙界下来的宝贝，名号自然要起得响亮。
story.en:
The token on your chest goes hot.

This time it stays hot for a long, long time.

A small, half-transparent silver fox slips out of the token. It crouches on your chest, looking down at {外门·伤处}, for a long, long time.

It doesn't speak. As sharp as its tongue usually is, right now it says nothing at all.

Then it opens its mouth and — *ptoo* — spits something out.

The thing lands on your chest with a clink. A little bronze furnace the size of your palm. Three legs, two ears, the body blue shot through with purple, carved all over with flames and clouds. On the lid crouches a small beast; it yawns, opens one eye, glances at you, and shuts it again.

⟪**Yinyue:** (very softly) This king's furnace. Brought down from the Immortal Realm. Keep it for this king.⟫

**You:** …What does it do?

⟪**Yinyue:** It makes pills. When you mortals make pills, seven furnaces in ten blow up… it doesn't. What it makes is… the best one… you can take. And it's picky… a pill it's tasted…⟫

Her voice gets smaller and smaller.

**You:** Yinyue?

⟪**Yinyue:** …it can also…⟫

She doesn't finish. Her body fades like a wisp of smoke. The last thing left is half a sentence, very, very soft:

⟪**Yinyue:** …next time… hit back…⟫

The token goes cool.

You sit in the mud holding the little bronze furnace, stunned, for a long time. What does "picky" mean? "It can also" — can also what?

The little beast on the lid opens one eye, glances at you, and shuts it again. It clearly knows. It clearly has no plans to tell you.

You turn it over. Carved on the bottom are a few characters, all curls, like cloud, like fire. You can't read a single one. Except the last: it's *dou*, 兜.

**You:** …What's your name?

The lid doesn't move.

A treasure come down from the Immortal Realm, you think, deserves a name that rings.

exits.means: names the furnace 镇天神炉 — the lid ignores it

snub.zh: 炉盖纹丝不动。小兽睁开一只眼睛，瞥了你一眼，又闭上了。
snub.en: The lid doesn't stir. The little beast opens one eye, glances at you, and shuts it again.

exits.means: names the furnace 九转金丹炉 — the lid ignores it

snub.zh: 仍是不动。小兽翻了个身，拿屁股对着你。
snub.en: Still nothing. The little beast rolls over and turns its backside to you.

label.en: One Furnace of Heaven and Earth

exits.means: names the furnace 乾坤一炉 — the lid ignores it

snub.zh: 炉盖纹丝不动。小兽打了个大大的哈欠，连眼皮都懒得抬。
snub.en: The lid doesn't stir. The little beast gives a huge yawn, too lazy even to lift an eyelid.

exits.means: names the furnace 饭桶 (rice bucket) — the only name it takes; takes the furnace, keeps it

story.zh:
你清了清嗓子，郑重其事地道：

**你**：从今往后，你便叫『镇天神炉』。

炉盖纹丝不动。

**你**：那……『九转金丹炉』？

仍是不动。

**你**：『紫霄』？『太乙』？『乾坤一炉』？

你一口气报了七八个，个个都是镇上说书先生嘴里的名号，它连动都懒得动一下，炉盖上那只小兽倒打了个大大的哈欠。

你说得口干舌燥，肚子又咕咕叫将起来，忍不住骂了一声：

**你**：你这饭桶，倒比我还难伺候。

话音未落，只听「咔哒」一声，炉盖轻轻一跳，那小兽竟睁开一只眼睛，冲你眨了一眨。

你呆了半晌，这才明白过来：它看上的，偏偏是「饭桶」两个字。
story.en:
You clear your throat and announce, with all due ceremony:

**You:** From this day on, you shall be called the Heaven-Quelling Divine Furnace.

The lid doesn't stir.

**You:** Then… the Nine-Turn Golden Elixir Furnace?

Still nothing.

**You:** Purple Empyrean? Great Unity? One Furnace of Heaven and Earth?

You reel off seven or eight in one breath, every one of them straight from the mouth of the storyteller in town, and it can't be bothered to so much as twitch; the little beast on the lid just gives a huge yawn.

By now your mouth is dry and your stomach starts rumbling again, and you can't help cursing:

**You:** You rice bucket — you're harder to please than I am.

The words are barely out when there's a *click*: the lid gives a little hop, and the beast actually opens one eye and winks at you.

You sit there dumbfounded a good while before it dawns on you: the name it fancies, of all things, is Rice Bucket — 饭桶.

refuse.zh: 炉盖纹丝不动。炉盖上的小兽打了个哈欠。
refuse.en: The lid doesn't stir. The little beast on the lid yawns.
